Monolith Soft.about: Monolith Soft Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary development company of Nintendo Co., Ltd, acquired in 2007. Its main Japan-based offices are located in Tokyo and Kyoto . The developer is mainly responsible for the Xenoblade series, but has also dedicated several resources to produce art assets in cooperation with main Nintendo Co., Ltd in-house titles.
releases: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

Retro Studios.about: Retro Studios Inc. is an American video game developer and subsidiary of Nintendo based in Austin, Texas. Retro was founded on September 21, 1998 as an alliance between Nintendo and former Iguana Entertainment founder Jeff Spangenberg, hoping to create titles for the then-upcoming GameCube aiming at an older demographic. The studio has established itself as a powerhouse with the Metroid Prime series and their revival of Donkey Kong Country.

Nintendo Cube.about: Nintendo Cube (formerly NDcube) is a subsidiary originally established as a collaboration between Nintendo and Dentsu. The studio had a resurgence after Hudson Soft was absorbed by Konami so, the Mario Party team joined the studio with a former Hudson Soft president leading the studio. The studio has done various minigame compilations such as Wii Party, the Mario Party series starting with 9 and Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics.
releases: Super Mario Party Jamboree Switch 2 Edition

1-UP Studio.about: 1-Up Studio is a game development studio founded in 2000 as Brownie Brown made of developers who worked on the Mana series. They collaborated with other publishers on a few titles in that early time including some Mana titles and Fantasy Life. In 2013, the studio was integrated fully as codevelopment studio for Nintendo with several of the original developers leaving to form Brownies. Since then, they have assisted in the design of 3D Mario games and supported games like Animal Crossing: New Horizons.
current: SMB Wonder - Meetup in Bellabel Park

Next Level Games.about: Next Level Games is a game development studio founded in 2002 in Vancouver, Canada from former EA Black Box staff. Nintendo acquired the studio in 2021. Next Level is best known for their work with Nintendo including their work on the Luigi's Mansion series.

Nintendo Software Technology.about: The studio was established in 1998 as a collaboration with the university, DigiPen Institute of Technology. The studio is largely taken from DigiPen graduatates and creates mostly smaller titles. More recently, they have assisted EPD in porting titles to new hardware.

Nintendo European Research & Development.about: Nintendo European Research & Development (NERD) is a European subsidiary based in Paris, France. It was formerly known as Mobiclip. It specializes in hardware middleware and classic game emulation.
releases: Nintendo DS Virtual Console on Wii U
Brain Training for Nintendo Switch (deep learning middleware for RPS game)
Ring Fit Adventure (heart rate IR detection)

iQue.about: iQue is a Chinese subsidiary based in Suzhou, China. They used to distribute Nintendo products in China such as the iQue Player. The brand was dropped in 2018 when, Tencent became the official distributor. As of 2017, iQue's main role is localization for China. They have recently hired developers to help with Nintendo EPD games and their first project is work on Super Mario 3D All-Stars. They have also done some earlier emulation work with the NES emulator on the 3DS and the N64 emulator on the Wii U.

SRD.about: SRD (Systems Research and Development) is a longtime partner of Nintendo going back to the Famicom. They have worked with Nintendo on programming on major titles from the original Super Mario Bros. to modern titles such as Tears of the Kingdom. Nintendo acquired them in 2022. They are also involved with Server Development across the company's titles.

Nintendo Pictures.about: Nintendo Pictures (formerly Dynamo Pictures) is Nintendo's animation studio that had formerly worked on CG and Motion Capture for various anime and productions. For Nintendo, they have worked on the Pikmin Short Movies and the short film "Close to You". Nintendo acquired them in 2022. Since then, they have been credited in both the Super Mario Movie, The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom and Super Mario Bros. Wonder. Additionally, they still provide motion capture and CG on some series like Precure

Shiver Entertainment.about: Shiver Entertainment is a developer based in Miami, Florida established in 2012 by former Electronic Arts executives, John Schappert and Jon Osvald. They have not worked directly with Nintendo prior to their acquisition but, they worked on several high-profile titles ported to the Nintendo Switch. In 2021, they were acquired by the Embracer Group for Saber Interactive. Nintendo acquired the developer from Embracer in May 2024. Since the acquisition, they have worked on WWE 2K25 for the Nintendo Switch 2.

Nintendo Studios Singapore.about: Nintendo Studios Singapore is a developer acquired from Bandai Namco in 2026. It was established in 2013, where it provided support work for various Bandai Namco Studios titles over the years including Mario Sports Superstars, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, Splatoon 3 and Kirby Air Riders. Its current CEO is Makoto Ishii.

Game Freak.about: Game Freak is the main developer for the Pokémon franchise, developing the main entries since the beginning of the franchise. The studio has also been attempting to develop some independent games with their younger developers called Gear Project. The company as of 2020 now shares a building with HAL Laboratory and Nintendo EPD in Tokyo

HAL Laboratory.about: HAL Laboratory is a long-time contracted developer for Nintendo since the Famicom. They are mainly known for being the studio behind Kirby. They operate out of Tokyo, Japan. They also develop some system tools for Nintendo hardware.
releases: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe

Intelligent Systems.about: Intelligent Systems is a long-time contracted developer for Nintendo since the Famicom. It's main office is in Kyoto, Japan. They are the developers responsible for Fire Emblem, Paper Mario and WarioWare. They also develop some system tools for Nintendo hardware.

Grezzo.about: Grezzo is a developer found in 2006 by former Mana series director, Koichi Ishii. They have mostly established themselves as a remake studio though they still have capable designers with their original work on Tri Force Heroes and Ever Oasis.
releases: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom

Genius Sonority.about: Genius Sonority is developer established in 2002 as a part of Yamauchi's Q Fund and made from former developers on the Dragon Quest series, Heartbeat. They were formed largely to support the Pokémon franchise
releases: Dragon Quest Swords: The Masked Queen and the Tower of Mirrors
current: The New Denpa Men RPG Free

The Pokémon Works.about: A joint venture between The Pokémon Company and ILCA established in 2024 to support the Pokémon franchise via Pokémon Home and other supporting software. They also contribute to the development of the mainline Pokémon series

epd_about: Nintendo's main development force is the Entertainment Planning & Development Division. It is the conglomeration of Nintendo's Entertainment Analysis & Development Division and Software Planning & Development and formed in 2015, occupying Nintendo's R&D plants in Kyoto & Tokyo. It consists of over 800 developers that range from pioneers of the original Famicom to fresh recruits that will lead the games of the future. The internal R&D developers primarily work on Nintendo's largest franchises such as The Legend of Zelda, Animal Crossing and Mario as well as Nintendo's major series of the future like Splatoon and Ring Fit Adventure.
